section: The sand under the first postcard, alive

options.name: Now
options.line: A photograph. The palm shadows and the leaf are part of the picture, so nothing moves until you scroll.

options.name: Breathing Shade
options.line: Your photograph untouched. The shadows that are already in it sway, and the leaf in the corner turns on its stem.

options.name: Live Palm
options.line: Clean sand, and the page casts the shadows itself: fronds moving over the sand and across the card, and a green leaf in the corner.

options.name: Gust
options.line: Calm, until the wind comes through: the shadows race, sand blows across the surface and the card's edge lifts. One comes as you start to scroll.
